simple.meaning: קָפָא (qâphâʼ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to shrink , i.e. thicken (as unracked wine, curdled milk, clouded sky, frozen water).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.

definitions.short: to shrink , i.e. thicken (as unracked wine, curdled milk, clouded sky, frozen water)
definitions.full: H7087. qapha ' [ קָפָא ] verb thicken, condense, congeal (compare Syriac heap up, collect ); — Qal Perfect 3plural תְהֹמֹת קָֽפְאוּ Exod 15:8 (song) the deeps were condensed , became firm walls; Imperfect יקפאון Zech 14:6 Kt (i.e. יִקְמָּא֑וּן [possible is also יִקָּפֵא֑וּן Niph`al ]) Thes and others glorious(?) ones [stars] shall contract (dwindle), but read Qr וְמָּאוֺן see following Participle עַלאשִׁמְרַיהֶם הַקֹּפְאִים Zeph 1:12 the men who are thickening on their lees (easy-going men, under figure of undisturbed wine). Hiph`il Imperfect 2masculine singular suffix תַּקְמִּיאֵנִי Job 10:10 didst thou not curdle me like cheese (of formation of foetus) ?
